verdict.rationale: Clara is a hosted corporate card and spend-management SaaS, and self-hosting is a fair question for software products of this kind. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable distribution, on-prem deployment, or open-source release. The API, MCP access, and an isolated sandbox environment are hosted developer features, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
